note: The M canon (/work/canon_m, config/r1/paths_aws_m.yaml) the final job assembles: pipeline/aws/r1/final_stage.py canon runs restore_upstream.py --stages j1a=/work/j1a --stages j1b=/work/j1b --layout this file --repo $REPO_DIR (every stage file digest-checked against its upstream <stage>.done.json before anything is copied), then writes CANON.json and the per-key MANIFESTs (tools/r1_canon.py) and requires CANON_OK against analysis/lib/canon_reads.tsv. Every canon_reads.tsv row under a canon key is covered (tests/test_r1_final.py): product rows come from J1a/J1b stage outputs, carried rows are the October files from the repo. Upstream contract: the J1a rows name W2-TJ1A's stages (promote: frames/ + expected/; events; frames_econ920: frames_econ/ (October basenames: star_set_econ_cal2026-10.parquet, build_report_econ920_2026-10.json with the run's report under 'october') + pairs/pairs_unified.csv; frames_chemmath_m: frames_<f>/ + yrebuild_chemmath/ (M review #8); the star-id edge supplement is the unchanged repo input J1a read (R1P3-04: no fetch); rank_tables: restake_r1.csv; new_numbers; star_origins_extract), and J1b's rob_post stage must leave the robustness products in the October cal-relative layout under work:prod/rob_post/canon/{robustness,cloud,cloud_t5}/ (W2-TJ1B). The P3a merged rosters are the committed files under data/cal2026-10r1/inputs/rosters/ (W3-MPIN). roster_chemmath_verified.parquet is the October verified table: ledger_funnel's cross-check needs an independent verified set, and one built from the R1 rosters would agree with them by construction (2026-10-17). Once j1a/j1b are marked complete, every stage row here must name one of that table's output tokens (test_canon_layout_names_only_outputs_of_complete_upstream_tables); until then a wrong name stops the canon stage loudly (MISSING_MARKER / MISSING_TOKEN / MISSING_FILE), never silently.
